sections.title: Proteins
sections.narration: 25 grams of protein. Essential amino acids score is 9 out of 9, making the protein useful for repair and maintenance. Collagen is 1.4 grams, weak for connective-tissue protein, so for meats, it is not bringing much connective-tissue protein. Strong protein is expected here, so the rest of the profile decides how high it climbs.

closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, vitamin B12, and zinc, but the biggest weaknesses are low potassium, saturated fat, and low vitamin D. It is good for blood and oxygen support, muscles and strength sports, and immune support because vitamin B12 and iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, the protein section supports repair and maintenance, and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
